rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is to last forever or indefinitely.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wui5 wing5 jyun5 gei3 zyu6 nei5

rows.note: Use this spoken pattern for a change that will remain true from now on, especially with a following verb or predicate.

example.english: From now on, I’ll permanently stop eating durian.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 hau6 dou1 m4 sik6 lau4 lin4

rows.note: Choose this mainly in official, technical, or written contexts for something intended to remain permanently in place.

example.english: This mural will be permanently preserved.
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 bik1 waa2 zoeng1 wing5 gau2 bou2 cyun4

rows.note: Use this for forever in the sense of lasting for a person's whole lifetime, often in emphatic speech.

example.english: I’ll permanently remember your kindness for the rest of my life.
example.traditional: 我一世都會記住你對我嘅好。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 sai3 dou1 wui5 gei3 zyu6 nei5 deoi3 ngo5 ge3 hou2
